explanation._note: Documentation only; ignored by build_classifier.py. Paths are relative to the project root unless absolute.
explanation.data_path: Path to the .npz file produced by generate_data.py. Must contain X, Y, and centers_global (RBF centers are chosen at data-generation time via compute_k_means, n_global_centers, and random_center_seed in generate_duffing_data.json—not in this file).
explanation.system_name: Name passed to SystemsAutonomous (e.g. duffing_eqn). Used to set default phase-space plot limits from the system's initial-condition bounds.
explanation.d_poly: Total degree of the polynomial part of the dictionary. Use -1 for RBFs only (no polynomial). Use 0, 1, 2, ... to include monomials up to that degree via CombinedDictionary(RBF, polynomial).
explanation.gamma: Bandwidth parameter for the Gaussian radial basis functions, exp(-gamma * ||x - c||^2). Larger gamma makes each RBF more localized around its center.
explanation.epsilon: Threshold for compute_approximate_invariant_observables: keep modes whose generalized eigenvalue is below this value.
explanation.idx_EDMD: Index into Koopman eigenmodes sorted by distance to koopman_eigenvalue_target (0 = closest). Used for Tier-1 (EDMD) contour and basin-separation plots.
explanation.idx_approximate_invariant: Index into approximate invariant modes from compute_approximate_invariant_observables (columns of lambda_vecs). Used for Tier-2 contour and basin plots.
explanation.koopman_eigenvalue_target: Target eigenvalue when sorting EDMD Koopman modes (typically 1.0 for an indicator-like eigenfunction).
explanation.epsilon_fix: Offset added to the mean of Re(phi) for Tier-1 basin mask threshold.
explanation.epsilon_fix_new: Offset added to the mean of Re(phi) for Tier-2 (approximate invariant) basin mask threshold.
explanation.grid_n: Number of points per axis on the phase-space grid for eigenfunction contour plots.
explanation.classifier_output_path: Where to write classifiers.npz: scaled coefficient vectors v_edmd and v_inv, basin thresholds, and dictionary parameters (centers_global, gamma, d_poly, n) to rebuild Phi. Phi itself is not stored (NumPy cannot save custom Python objects portably in .npz).
